findings.requirement: Candidate base, merge preview and exact-head CI/handoff must be fresh against develop.
findings.summary: The prior certificate and green CI were tied to base 5887f31 after develop advanced, leaving PR #1022 dirty/non-mergeable and the release evidence stale.

findings.requirement: The regression contract must detect loss of an individual required scenario, not only loss of the file or all tests.
findings.summary: The prior guard checked file existence plus at least one test, so deleting one required case from a multi-test file could remain green.

findings.requirement: Testing documentation must reflect the current boundary between technical rollout implementation and operational rollout execution.
findings.summary: The prior PR/docs still described #898 as lacking rollout/cohort implementation after its technical implementation had merged; real operational execution is tracked separately by #1024.
